articles.title: “Family Outing Turns Fatal!” 9 Killed as Car Plunges Into Well in Nashik
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a tragic accident in Maharashtra’s Nashik district, nine members of a single family, including six children, lost their lives after their car fell into a water-filled well late Friday night (03 Feb 2026).

body.html:
In a tragic accident in Maharashtra’s Nashik district, nine members of a single family, including six children, lost their lives after their car fell into a water-filled well late Friday night (03 Feb 2026).

The incident occurred around 11:30 pm in Dindori taluka, nearly 40 km from Nashik, when the family was returning home after attending a function in Shivajinagar. The vehicle, driven by Sunil Dattatreya Dargode (34), reportedly went out of control and veered off the road before plunging into a nearby well.

Due to the well being completely filled with water, rescue operations proved extremely challenging. Police, fire brigade, disaster response teams, and later NDRF personnel were deployed. The car was eventually pulled out using cranes after several hours.

Nine bodies were recovered from the vehicle, while a search operation was also carried out for another girl who was reportedly thrown out during the accident and submerged in the water.

The deceased include Sunil, his wife Reshma (30), their daughter Rakhi alias Gunvanti (10), along with nieces Madhuri (13) and Shravani (11). Other victims include Asha Anil Dargode (32), her children Shreyash (11) and Srishti (14), and niece Samruddhi (7).

All victims belonged to the same extended family, deepening the scale of the tragedy.

Eyewitnesses described emotional scenes at the site, with several children still dressed in function attire as their bodies were recovered.

Dindori Police have registered a case and initiated an investigation. Preliminary findings suggest the accident may have been caused by the driver losing control of the vehicle.

#Nashik #Maharashtra #RoadAccident #Tragedy #BreakingNews

articles.title: “Peace Talks Turn Bloodshed!” Love Marriage Row Sparks Violent Clash in Chitradurga
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dispute over a love marriage in Bharamasagara village of Karnataka’s Chitradurga district turned violent after a peace meeting between two families escalated into a physical clash, leaving several people injured.

body.html:
A dispute over a love marriage in Bharamasagara village of Karnataka’s Chitradurga district turned violent after a peace meeting between two families escalated into a physical clash, leaving several people injured.

The conflict centres around Bhavana of Bharamasagara and Teertheshwara Naik from Bevinahalli, who registered their marriage on February 8 despite strong opposition from their families. The couple are related, which further intensified tensions.

According to reports, relations between the families had been strained since the wedding. The situation worsened after allegations of religious conversion were levelled against Teertheshwara Naik, adding to the ongoing dispute.

In an attempt to resolve the matter, a meeting was organised, but it soon turned into a heated argument and then a violent confrontation. During the clash, Bhavana’s grand-uncle, Mallesh Naik, along with two others, was allegedly assaulted and is currently undergoing treatment at Chitradurga District Hospital.

Teertheshwara Naik’s family has also claimed that they were attacked, with both sides accusing each other, complicating the case further. A video allegedly showing the assault has gone viral, fuelling public debate. Reports suggesting the incident occurred in the presence of police have added to the controversy.

Police from Bharamasagara station reached the spot, brought the situation under control, and deployed additional personnel to maintain law and order. Officials confirmed that an investigation is underway and assured that action will be taken against those responsible.

The village remains tense as authorities continue efforts to defuse the situation.

#Chitradurga #Karnataka #LoveMarriage #FamilyClash #BreakingNews

articles.title: “Pregnant Woman Assaulted at Health Centre?” ANM Accused of Attack Amid Card Dispute in Haryana
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A major controversy broke out at a sub-health centre in Gharaunda, Karnal district of Haryana, where a pregnant woman allegedly faced assault during a visit to get her ANC (health) card made.

body.html:
A major controversy broke out at a sub-health centre in Gharaunda, Karnal district of Haryana, where a pregnant woman allegedly faced assault during a visit to get her ANC (health) card made.

According to the complainants, the incident took place on Thursday when locals, including Ruchin Goyal and Kuldeep, had come with their relatives—both pregnant women—to the centre for documentation. They alleged that the Auxiliary Nurse Midwife (ANM) present at the facility was initially absent and later arrived in an agitated state, refusing to process the cards and engaging in an argument.

The situation soon escalated into a physical altercation. The family alleged that the ANM picked up a stick and attacked them, during which one pregnant woman was hit on the hand. They further claimed that when they started recording the incident, the ANM became more aggressive, slapped a youth who intervened, scratched faces, and attempted to snatch a mobile phone.

The complainants also stated that they had been visiting the centre for several days to get the card made but were repeatedly turned away.

However, the accused ANM, Mamta Rani, has denied all allegations, calling them baseless. She claimed that the patient’s family misbehaved, pushed her, and even scratched her. According to her, she picked up the stick in self-defence and did not attack anyone. She also alleged that she was threatened and has filed a counter-complaint with the police.

A video of the incident has surfaced on social media, showing a heated argument and scuffle inside the health centre.

Gharaunda Police confirmed that complaints have been received from both sides and an investigation is underway. Health department officials have also taken cognisance, with senior authorities reviewing the matter.

The incident has raised concerns over safety and conduct at public health facilities.

#Haryana #Karnal #Gharaunda #BreakingNews #ViralVideo

articles.title: “Shashi Tharoor Convoy Attacked!” Security Guard Assaulted During Kerala Campaign, 3 Detained
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The convoy of Congress MP Shashi Tharoor was allegedly blocked and a member of his security team assaulted in Kerala’s Malappuram district on Friday.

body.html:
The convoy of Congress MP Shashi Tharoor was allegedly blocked and a member of his security team assaulted in Kerala’s Malappuram district on Friday.

The incident occurred near Thiruvalli Chellithodu bridge when the Thiruvananthapuram MP was en route to an election campaign event in Wandoor. A video from the spot showed a group of men surrounding his vehicle and raising slogans.

Confirming the incident on X, Tharoor said his security guard was attacked but is now safe, while he remained unharmed. He added that despite the disruption, the convoy continued and he went on to complete two scheduled campaign events.

Following a complaint by the security personnel, Wandoor Police registered a case, detained three individuals, and seized two vehicles. A non-bailable case has been filed against one accused, identified as Ummara, a resident of Kalikavu.

Kerala is set to go to polls in a single phase on April 9, with counting scheduled for May 4.

#ShashiTharoor #Kerala #Malappuram #Election2026 #BreakingNews

articles.title: “Drone Crash Sparks Panic!” UAV Test Flight Goes Wrong in Etawah Village
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A helicopter-like drone crashed into a wheat field in Nandpur village under the Saifai area of Etawah district on Friday evening around 6:30 pm, triggering panic among local residents.

body.html:
A helicopter-like drone crashed into a wheat field in Nandpur village under the Saifai area of Etawah district on Friday evening around 6:30 pm, triggering panic among local residents.

According to officials, the drone crash occurred during a test flight being conducted by LAT Aerospace with prior permission from the Civil Aviation Department. The UAV (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) reportedly lost control due to a technical fault and fell into the field.

The unusual helicopter-like appearance of the drone created fear among villagers, leading to a large crowd gathering at the spot. Locals immediately informed the police.

Police and fire brigade teams rushed to the scene, cordoned off the area as a precaution, and ensured public safety. Officials also initiated an on-site inspection.

Additional District Magistrate Abhinav Ranjan Srivastava confirmed that the test flight was authorised from the Saifai airstrip and clarified that no casualties or property damage were reported. He termed the incident a technical accident and ruled out any major security threat.

#Etawah #DroneCrash #BreakingNews #UAV #AviationNews

articles.title: “Burqa-Clad Robber Exposed!” Woman Uses Fake Pistol to Loot Jewellery Shop in Broad Daylight
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking daylight robbery in Ayodhya’s Rudauli Kotwali area has raised serious concerns over public safety after a woman, posing as a customer, looted a jewellery shop at gunpoint and fled with her accomplice.

body.html:
A shocking daylight robbery in Ayodhya’s Rudauli Kotwali area has raised serious concerns over public safety after a woman, posing as a customer, looted a jewellery shop at gunpoint and fled with her accomplice.

The incident took place around 12:30 pm on Thursday at Mahesh Jewellers in Agarwal Complex. The accused woman, dressed in a burqa and carrying a bag, entered the shop and asked to see a gold necklace and chain. She behaved normally, arousing no suspicion.

To execute the theft, she cleverly distracted the shop staff. She first asked for water, refused samosas, and then demanded sweets, sending employees out on errands. Taking advantage of the distraction, she quickly placed around 26 grams of gold jewellery, worth approximately ₹3.6 lakh, into her bag.

When the shopkeeper grew suspicious and tried to stop her, she pulled out a pistol and threatened to shoot him. Terrified, no one intervened. The woman then fled the shop, where her accomplice was already waiting on a motorcycle. Despite attempts by the shopkeeper and locals to chase them, the duo managed to escape.

The entire incident was captured on CCTV cameras, following which police scanned footage from over 50 cameras and launched a search operation. The area was briefly cordoned off, and teams were formed to trace the accused.

In a later development, police identified and arrested the accused. The woman, identified as Payal (25), and her accomplice Rahul were taken into custody. Police revealed that the pistol used in the robbery was a toy gun. Payal, who is married and resides in Punjab, had come to Ayodhya to appear for her UP Board Class 12 exams. The burqa and fake weapon were reportedly purchased by Rahul to carry out the crime.

Police confirmed that both accused have been apprehended and further investigation is underway.

#Ayodhya #Robbery #BreakingNews #CrimeNews #ViralVideo

articles.title: “Wedding Night Turns Violent!” Groom Attacked with Brick After Bride Refuses Marriage in UP
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A day after their wedding on March 29, a dispute between a newlywed couple in Bilaspur’s Laxminagar locality of Rampur district, Uttar Pradesh, escalated into violence involving both families. According to reports, Kanhaiya (22) from Rampur had married Gulab from Kichha in Uttarakhand.

body.html:
A day after their wedding on March 29, a dispute between a newlywed couple in Bilaspur’s Laxminagar locality of Rampur district, Uttar Pradesh, escalated into violence involving both families.

According to reports, Kanhaiya (22) from Rampur had married Gulab from Kichha in Uttarakhand. On the wedding night, an argument broke out after the bride allegedly refused physical contact. The situation escalated, and the groom claimed he was slapped by the bride, prompting family members to intervene.

The matter intensified the next day during a panchayat convened to resolve the dispute. During the meeting, tensions flared, and members of the bride’s family allegedly assaulted the groom, hitting him on the head with a brick and leaving him seriously injured. He was later admitted to a hospital for treatment.

In a second panchayat held later in the evening, the bride reportedly refused to continue the marriage. Following discussions, both families reached a written settlement. The bride returned to her parental home in Uttarakhand, and police confirmed that no further legal action was taken after recording statements from both sides.

The incident has raised concerns over rising cases of disputes turning violent within hours of marriage.

#Rampur #UttarPradesh #WeddingDispute #ViralNews #DomesticViolence

articles.title: Roof-Top Reel Stunt on Moving Thar in Hapur Sparks Outrage | Police Order Action
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video showing three youths performing a dangerous stunt atop a moving Mahindra Thar on Bulandshahr Road in Hapur’s nagar area has gone viral on social media.

body.html:
A video showing three youths performing a dangerous stunt atop a moving Mahindra Thar on Bulandshahr Road in Hapur’s nagar area has gone viral on social media.

In the footage, the youths are seen sitting on the roof of the speeding vehicle while recording reels, openly violating traffic rules and endangering lives. The vehicle continues to race along the road as the stunt is carried out in full public view.

The clip has triggered concern over reckless behaviour and road safety violations.

Hapur Police have taken note of the viral video and stated that the concerned officials have been directed to investigate the matter and initiate necessary action.

articles.title: Ambulance Video Sparks Row After Anganwadi Worker’s Death, Probe Finds Claims ‘Baseless’
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A controversy erupted after the death of an Anganwadi worker in Uttar Pradesh, when a viral video recorded inside an ambulance alleged official harassment. However, an inquiry ordered by the administration has found the claims to be unsubstantiated.

body.html:
A controversy erupted after the death of an Anganwadi worker in Uttar Pradesh, when a viral video recorded inside an ambulance alleged official harassment. However, an inquiry ordered by the administration has found the claims to be unsubstantiated.

The deceased, Preeti, a resident of Sadar area, was working as an Anganwadi worker and was also deployed as a Booth Level Officer (BLO). According to family members, she had been unwell for several days and was initially admitted to a private hospital. As her condition worsened, she was being shifted to Lucknow for advanced treatment but died en route near Sitapur.

During the journey, her daughter Smita recorded a video alleging that District Programme Officer Arvind Kumar and a municipal clerk had harassed her mother. She claimed that Preeti had not received her salary for four months and was still being pressured to work, which allegedly worsened her health.

The video quickly went viral, prompting District Magistrate Dharmendra Pratap Singh to take cognisance and order a probe by the city magistrate.

However, the inquiry report submitted by City Magistrate Praveen Singh reportedly found the allegations to be baseless. Officials stated that salary payments had already been credited to all Anganwadi workers, including Preeti, by March 16, and records were available to support this.

District Programme Officer Arvind Kumar denied all allegations, asserting that no harassment had taken place and that the claims were completely false.

Notably, the family neither filed a formal complaint nor conducted a post-mortem examination.

The district administration has assured that all aspects of the case were examined and that necessary support would be extended to the family.

#UttarPradesh #Anganwadi #Sitapur #BreakingNews #ViralVideo
